versions.content: Use Case Specific Extension of Formula Language A use case specific extension is indicated in the meta model by a specialization of FormulaExpression . The semantics of the extension is specified in the context of this specialization as a fragment of an ANTLR [11] specification redefining the following Tokens:  ExtKeyword - this provides additional keywords similar to epsilon  ExtUnaryFuncName - this provides additional names for unary functions  ExtBinaryFuncName - this provides additional names for binary functions 110 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 It is not possible to extend the formula language by additional operators.
